description: Search scans by meaning, comparing text with screenshot embeddings (for example 'bank login page asking for card details'). threshold defaults to -0.2 on a -1 to 1 scale; text-to-image scores are usually around -0.4 to 0.1, so useful thresholds are around -0.3 to 0. An empty result means nothing met the chosen threshold.

query.description: Plain-language description of the page to find, for example 'bank login page asking for card details'.
query.title: Query

threshold.description: Minimum similarity, -1 to 1 (default -0.2); text-to-screenshot scores usually fall between -0.4 and 0.1.
threshold.title: Threshold

name: search_semantic
title: Search Semantic
